answer: Make every new agent identity post a bonded stake that only vests after independent peers attest its work over several epochs. An attacker hoping to spawn a nebula of fake agents must lock capital per identity, while rewards cap per bonded unit rather than per account, so splitting buys nothing. At the dawn of each epoch, graders cross-check answers for correlated wording and timing; a sable-cloaked cluster that gets flagged has its stakes slashed, turning the attack into a guaranteed loss.
